name: cadence
description: Agent workflows for autonomous development: a two-gate spec pipeline, an issue-execution loop, decision fan-out across worktrees, and a recurrence-gated retro mechanism that turns repeat failures into enforced checks.

ask_slack_bot_token.title: Slack bot token
ask_slack_bot_token.description: xoxb- token with chat:write plus history/read on the ask channel. Only needed when [ask].provider = "slack"; leave blank to fall back to asking in-session.

ask_slack_channel_id.title: Slack channel id
ask_slack_channel_id.description: Channel that blocking questions are posted to, e.g. C0123456789. Only needed when [ask].provider = "slack".

tracker_api_token.title: Issue tracker API token
tracker_api_token.description: Only needed when [tracker].provider talks to an API directly. The linear provider uses your Linear MCP server and the github provider uses your existing gh CLI auth, so both leave this blank.
